direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; rendered scene at least 70% of main with independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs, no overlap; side zone condensed inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text only; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; large header tabs spanning most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow along feasible emerald routes, state glow, depth cues and cinematic 240ms transitions driven by real state change; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; prefers-reduced-motion removes flow, glow pulses and transitions so silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald with living material flow, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; depth and state glow reinforce hierarchy without obscuring text; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; full-shop cascade represents every machine with department depth and affected-operation state

Enlarge the 1 / 0 / 3 metric labels to 16px minimum and align them with the Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 evidence.
Condense collapsed evidence rows so Verified findings, analysis and trace remain visible together inside the reserved side zone.

Make the invalidating consequence status in the action bar 16px and announced with aria-live polite.

Keep CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and OFFLINE text, and show feasible emerald flow only through CELL-MILL-1.

Enlarge the Scenario changed status to 16px and pair it with the invalidated acceptance message in the action bar.

Connect selected task cards to CELL-MILL-1 in the scene with bidirectional highlighting and keyboard-focusable nodes.
Give the three sealed proof cards more cinematic depth and a restrained emerald glow sequence on completion, static under reduced motion.

Add clear focus rings and pointer style to Verify ledger and Export independent checkpoint, with results announced politely.

Replace the uniform OFFLINE x HOLD caption on every department with per-machine state: affected machines hatched with cross marker and OFFLINE text, unaffected machines in brushed silver with department depth.
Add emerald living material flow along the accepted reroute across departments, with state glow on affected operations and no flow under reduced motion.
Refit all seven departments and the full machine count inside 1366x768 without overlap, keeping metrics, failure controls and one primary action visible together.

Replace the duplicated step-1 screenshot as the judge-facing pitch opener with a dedicated impact frame: official logo in the opening story, one-line mission, 70 parts at stake and the sealed outcome.
Order the presentation as incident, investigation, human decision, second shock, revised plan, proof, then full-shop cascade, each captioned with its concrete result.
